title: Detection and Analysis of Lane Wandering and Cut-Out Scenarios in Naturalistic Driving Data for Automated Driving Safety Assessment
source_filter: ego/new-lead TTC greater than 15 s and identified data errors removed
duration_mapping: For a complete lateral displacement D, T=D/mean_lateral_speed; average speed is not peak speed
scope: Univariate cut-out maneuver statistics only; no dependency fit. Stationary new lead is a separate fixed test condition from the assessment protocol, not a claimed property of all 829 naturalistic cases.

proposed_design.sampling: independent uniform primitive parameters, Sobol design, 2000 target candidates and 512 separate historical design points

source_roles.speeds: Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v2.2, section 3.2.1.4: independently interpolate the ego 70/90 km/h and lead 50/70 km/h endpoint levels rather than retaining only the two paired standard cases
source_roles.initial_following_clearance: Cai et al., DOI 10.3390/machines11040426, section 4.1, Figure 7(a), Table 2: body clearance in the initial two-vehicle constant-speed following phase; this is a declared composition of logical scenario phases
source_roles.mean_lateral_speed: Wallis et al., section IV.B, Figure 4(b): left cut-out 5th-95th percentile envelope
source_roles.stationary_target_and_trigger: Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v2.2, section 3.2.1.4: stationary third vehicle and lead-to-target TTC=3 s at cut-out onset

fixed_conditions.event_time_origin: t=0 at cut-out onset; any required observation history must be generated by actual preceding execution and aligned to this state

proposed_design.proposed_lateral_profile: y(t)=D*(10*s^3-15*s^4+6*s^5), s=clip(t/T,0,1), T=D/mean_lateral_speed; zero lateral speed and acceleration at endpoints
engineering_extensions: Independent continuous speed envelopes replace two paired standard speed settings
The initial following clearance domain and subsequent cut-out event come from role-matched sources; the resulting product design is not an observed natural joint distribution

A fixed smooth quintic lateral profile with naturalistic mean-speed limits replaces the standard's prescribed curvature, radius and 1.5 m/s^2 acceleration; this is not a complete Euro NCAP reproduction
predeclared_feasibility: Initial full vehicle footprints do not overlap
The complete lane change finishes within 10 s and is within the common execution dynamics

The scripted lead footprint clears the stationary obstacle along its entire prescribed path; evaluate this deterministic background geometry without querying any ADS collision, RSS or discovery result
Source ranges are not changed in response to candidate acceptance or ADS failure counts; disclose dependencies caused by feasibility filtering

remaining_gate: Verify actual map lane width, full-footprint background geometry, original ADS observation history and dynamics before freezing; old trajectories and coordinates unchanged
